top_signals.title: Whitney Warns of Economic Reckoning This Year, Sees Fed on Hold
top_signals.summary: Meredith Whitney, the former bank analyst who rose to fame for a 2007 report ahead of the global financial crisis, warned that a US “reckoning” is coming in the fourth quarter as one-time economic boosts from the World Cup and residual fiscal spending fade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
